fail_closed_rules: Every authority identifier used by a finding or route must resolve to an authority card.
Every retrieval-eligible authority card must be current_verified.
Current-law output cannot use a known stale section after an amendment effective date.
Another state's substantive law cannot be represented as New Hampshire law.
The suite must never mark output filing-ready or legal advice.
The suite cannot be promoted as attorney-reviewed gold without independent review and adjudication.
